Amit Shah to inaugurate exhibition on new criminal laws, policing in Bhopal

Union Home Minister Amit Shah is scheduled to visit Bhopal on October 3 to inaugurate an exhibition focused on new criminal laws and policing. He will also participate in a conference of over 35,000 cattle rearers, where he is expected to launch several projects, including a dairy plant.
